title: StockSmart Credit Desk Schedule — Credit Room Share on Opening Consigned Stock
content:
**Applies to:** the opening consigned stock of a new StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines.

**Rule.** The receivable balance of the customer's Commercial Credit Account divided by its credit limit puts a credit-room share into the carried share: 0.9 or more puts 0.7, 0.75 or more but below 0.9 puts 0.85, and less puts no credit-room share in, leaving the carried share as it is; an account with no credit limit, or no account on record, counts as 0.9 or more.

| Receivable balance divided by credit limit | Credit-room share |
|---|---|
| 0.9 or more | 0.7 |
| 0.75 or more, below 0.9 | 0.85 |
| below 0.75 | none put in |
| no credit limit, or no Commercial Credit Account on record | 0.7 (counts as 0.9 or more) |

**Hypothetical accounts.** Receivable 45000.00 on a 50000.00 limit: 0.9 exactly, so 0.7. Receivable 37500.00 on the same limit: 0.75 exactly, so 0.85. Receivable 30000.00: 0.6, so none.
